title: Nasri receives Palestine’s Ambassador to Algeria
description: ALGIERS - The Speaker of the Council of the Nation (Upper House of Parliament), Azouz Nasri, received Wednesday, at the Council's headquarters, the Ambassador of the State of Palestine to Algeria, Fayez Abu Aita, who paid him a courtesy visit, according to a statement issued by the Council.

title: President Tebboune conducts partial reshuffle of provincial governors, local officials
description: ALGIERS - President of the Republic Abdelmadjid Tebboune on Wednesday carried out a partial reshuffle of provincial governors, governors, and provincial secretaries general in accordance with Article 92 of the Constitution, the Ministry of Interior, Local Authorities and Transport said Wednesday in a statement.

title: Algeria's hosting of 31st AIPA, historic milestone
description: ALGIERS - Chem Widhya, Secretary-General of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (AIPA), affirmed on Wednesday that Algeria’s hosting of the 31st session of the Assembly marks a historic event, as it is being held on the African continent for the first time.

title: President Tebboune chairs meeting to finalize decree on one-stop shop
description: ALGIERS - President of the Republic Abdelmadjid Tebboune on Wednesday chaired a working meeting to finalize the presidential decree on the one-stop shop and its commissioning, a move expected to energize investment by streamlining procedures and improving the business climate, the Presidency of the Republic said in a statement.

title: Experts highlight national investment in infrastructure, production and human capital for sustainable growth
description: ALGIERS - Economic experts have highlighted Algeria's sustained economic dynamism in recent years, driven by a comprehensive framework of programs, projects, and multi-sector initiatives, anchored in strategic investments aimed at strengthening infrastructure, expanding productive capacity, and developing human capital.

title: Several sectors on Government meeting agenda
description: ALGIERS - Prime Minister Sifi Ghrieb chaired a Government meeting on Wednesday to review issues related to the supply of basic foodstuffs to the domestic market, the El Menea-In Saleh-Tamanrasset railway project, and water security enhancement, according to a statement from the Prime Minister’s Office.

title: Algeria, Kuwait hold anti-corruption talks in Doha
description: ALGIERS - A delegation from the High Authority for Transparency, Prevention, and the Fight against Corruption, led by Acting President M'Hamed Djellaoui, held a working session in Doha, Qatar, with the President of the Kuwait Anti-Corruption Authority, Rana Abdullah Al-Fares, the Authority said Wednesday in a statement.

title: Attaf partakes in consultative meeting of Arab FMs in New York
description: NEW YORK - The Minister of State, Minister of Foreign Affairs, National Community Abroad, and African Affairs, Ahmed Attaf, participated on Tuesday in a consultative meeting of Arab foreign ministers in New York.

title: Attaf meets with several African, European counterparts
description: ALGIERS - Minister of State, Minister of Foreign Affairs, National Community Abroad and African Affairs Ahmed Attaf held talks on Tuesday with several African and European counterparts on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), according to a ministry statement.

title: President Tebboune orders comprehensive wage increase for Civil Protection corps
description: ALGIERS - President of the Republic Abdelmadjid Tebboune, chairing a Council of Ministers meeting on Sunday, ordered a comprehensive increase in wages for Civil Protection personnel and a revision of their statutory framework, in line with climate change and the major risks faced by members of this corps, according to a statement issued by the Council of Ministers.
